description: Land Title Settlement Department -  Mallawapitiya, Mallawapitiya D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420201
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, ownership details, and encumbrances) in Mallawapitiya, Kurunegala District. The content focuses entirely on land ownership, title settlement, and property registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
